text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Racecourse was brimming with 
lively energy. 
With entry restrictions relaxed even 
further—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaah...! 
It's been so long! Whoa, I'm actually 
tearing up!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I totally get it! 
We're finally meeting at the 
racecourse...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, excuse me... 
Are you... "All-Out Tact Cheerleader"...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! Then are you "Dreams Come 
True Girl"? 
Rooting for Daring Tact together on social 
media 
kept my spirits up so much...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... buzz...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! 
There are so many people...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Feels like it's been forever 
since I last saw this many people at the 
track...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...This was supposed to be the norm, 
wasn't it? 
Thinking about that, the girls racing 
behind closed doors...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. But that's precisely why... 
all the fans are so fired up right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
They want to pour out every drop of love 
they couldn't share before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Tact. 
Now's your time to bloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's excitement came through loud 
and clear. 
It wasn't an unspoken, suppressed 
anticipation like before— 
it was pure, direct heat.
choice_data_list: Don't let the atmosphere overwhelm you.
Don't let the atmosphere overwhelm you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
But I'm sure... I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back in my Junior Year, all this heat 
might have overwhelmed me. But...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now, I understand... 
every single voice is a precious spark of 
life shining through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And today, the lion's share of those 
voices belonged to her. 
Overshadowing the new generation, Daring 
Tact 
stood uncontested in the spotlight.
choice_data_list: Let's surpass the you of the past.
Let's surpass the you of the past.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The only way to answer everyone's 
cheers... 
is with an overwhelming victory 
worthy of the name "Daring Tact."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm going out there to win— 
I won't yield to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will show everyone a fully revived... 
and far stronger "Daring Tact"!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Tact. 
...The day has finally arrived, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Seeing so many people gathered together... 
I can even hear their voices.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
My heart is racing! 
...Though I'm sure you're totally unfazed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You don't seem worried either, Win 
Marilyn. 
When we went to watch the Shuka Sho 
together, 
you were so composed and dignified, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 
...Ahaha, that time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You were always encouraging me, Win 
Marilyn... 
You were so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did it look that way? Then I must've 
put on 
quite the convincing performance!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... I couldn't sleep a wink 
that night. 
I kept wondering if I could ever deliver 
results 
under that kind of crushing pressure...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Was that really how it was?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I may have stage experience 
under my belt, 
but the racing world is an entirely 
different beast.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I was anxious the whole time. 
...Until you shone your light on me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Listen, you have it completely backwards! 
You were the one who was impossibly 
dependable!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
When they decided to close the gates, and 
on the day itself... 
you were the only one who stood tall and 
proud.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
With that one-of-a-kind Triple Tiara, 
you—you gave all of us courage.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
There was no bravado in you, no 
performance. 
You just ran true— 
and remained steadfastly "Daring Tact."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...I admired you. I was jealous, too. 
Because you had the radiant presence of a 
true star.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...To think that you felt 
that way about me...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, you shouldn't be surprised at 
all! 
That's just how incredible you really are.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
That's why today—I want to stand beside 
you. 
As an equal rival!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Polished to perfection, I, Win Marilyn, 
will draw out every last bit of your 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'm going to take you down! 
Well? What do you say, am I a worthy 
opponent or what?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt! 
Win Marilyn—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Greater than we were back then, 
let us shine—at our absolute brightest!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, she's coming out!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Daring Tact!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best!" "You've got this, you can 
win!" 
"We know how strong you are, Daring Tact! 
—Bring back the ecstasy of that day once 
more...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...Joyful voices. Sparkling gazes. 
Every single drop of heat... pouring 
directly into me.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —I will answer them, without fail!

title: Toward the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
